	lr_usa_mg_loyalty_start = yes

}

lr_usa_civil_war_end = {
	clr_global_flag = LR_usa_civil_war
	clr_country_flag = LR_usa_civil_war_on
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = LR_usa_brothers_war }
		remove_ideas = LR_usa_brothers_war
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = LR_usa_burning_streets }
		remove_ideas = LR_usa_burning_streets
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = LR_usa_red_agitation }
		remove_ideas = LR_usa_red_agitation
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = LR_usa_martial_law }
		remove_ideas = LR_usa_martial_law
	}
}

lr_usa_on_capitulation = {
	# The governor falls to the Congress.
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = USA
			CNA = { exists = yes has_war_with = USA }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = CNA is_in_faction_with = CNA } }
		}
		CNA = {
			annex_country = {
				target = USA
				transfer_troops = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = lr_usa.20 }
		}
	}
	# The Congress falls to the governor or to Britain.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CNA
			USA = { exists = yes }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = LR_usa_civil_war }
		}
		USA = {
			annex_country = {
				target = CNA
				transfer_troops = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = lr_usa.30 }
		}
	}
	# Canada falls to the Congress marching north.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CAN
			CNA = { exists = yes has_country_flag = LR_usa_canada_march }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = CNA is_in_faction_with = CNA } }
		}
		CNA = {
			annex_country = {
				target = CAN
				transfer_troops = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = lr_usa.22 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { tag = USA tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE }
			USA = { exists = yes has_country_flag = LR_usa_annex_americas }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = USA is_in_faction_with = USA } }
			capital_scope = { OR = { is_on_continent = north_america is_on_continent = south_america } }
		}
		USA = { country_event = { id = lr_usa.86 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { tag = USA tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE }
			CNA = { exists = yes has_country_flag = LR_usa_annex_americas }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = CNA is_in_faction_with = CNA } }
			capital_scope = { OR = { is_on_continent = north_america is_on_continent = south_america } }
		}
		CNA = { country_event = { id = lr_usa.86 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { tag = USA tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE }
			AMC = { exists = yes has_country_flag = LR_usa_annex_americas }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = AMC is_in_faction_with = AMC } }
			capital_scope = { OR = { is_on_continent = north_america is_on_continent = south_america } }
		}
		AMC = { country_event = { id = lr_usa.86 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { tag = USA tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE }
			LNG = { exists = yes has_country_flag = LR_usa_annex_americas }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = LNG is_in_faction_with = LNG } }
			capital_scope = { OR = { is_on_continent = north_america is_on_continent = south_america } }
		}
		LNG = { country_event = { id = lr_usa.86 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { tag = USA tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE }
			DXE = { exists = yes has_country_flag = LR_usa_annex_americas }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = DXE is_in_faction_with = DXE } }
			capital_scope = { OR = { is_on_continent = north_america is_on_continent = south_america } }
		}
		DXE = { country_event = { id = lr_usa.86 } }
	}
	# The civil war: the winner takes the loser whole.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = LR_usa_civil_war
			OR = { tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE } }
		}
		FROM = {
			annex_country = {
				target = ROOT
				transfer_troops = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = lr_usa.49 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

lr_usa_mg_loyalty_update = {
	clamp_variable = {
		var = LR_usa_loyalty
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
	set_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty_m0 = LR_usa_loyalty }
	subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty_m0 = 50 }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty_m0 = 0.003 }
	set_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty_m1 = LR_usa_loyalty }
	subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty_m1 = 50 }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty_m1 = 0.006 }
}

lr_usa_mg_loyalty_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_loyalty } }
		set_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_loyalty
		set_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty = 40 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_mg_loyalty }
		lr_usa_mg_loyalty_update = yes
	}
}

lr_usa_mg_loyalty_stop = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_loyalty }
		clr_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_loyalty
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_mg_loyalty }
	}
}

		clr_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_plan
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_mg_plan }
	}
}

lr_usa_mg_popularity_update = {
	clamp_variable = {
		var = LR_usa_popularity
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
	set_variable = { LR_usa_popularity_m0 = LR_usa_popularity }
	subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_popularity_m0 = 50 }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_popularity_m0 = 0.003 }
	set_variable = { LR_usa_popularity_m1 = LR_usa_popularity }
	subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_popularity_m1 = 50 }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_popularity_m1 = 0.003 }
}

lr_usa_mg_popularity_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_popularity } }
		set_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_popularity
		set_variable = { LR_usa_popularity = 50 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_mg_popularity }
		lr_usa_mg_popularity_update = yes
	}
}

lr_usa_mg_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_loyalty }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_loyalty = 1 }
		lr_usa_mg_loyalty_update = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_union }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_union = 1 }
		lr_usa_mg_union_update = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_order }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_order = 2 }
		lr_usa_mg_order_update = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_army }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_army = 1 }
		lr_usa_mg_army_update = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_mg_plan }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_plan = 1 }
		lr_usa_mg_plan_update = yes
	}

		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_planters = 1 }
		lr_usa_mg_planters_update = yes
	}
}

lr_usa_regions_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_regions } }
		set_country_flag = LR_usa_regions
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_new_england = 50 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_mid_atlantic = 45 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_chesapeake = 50 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_great_lakes = 45 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_upper_south = 45 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_deep_south = 40 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_plains = 45 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_mountain_west = 50 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pacific = 50 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_regions }
	}
}

lr_usa_regions_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { tag = USA tag = CNA tag = AMC tag = LNG tag = DXE } }

		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_count = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_state = { OR = { state = 357 OR = { state = 1162 state = 860 } state = 1163 state = 1164 state = 1165 } } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_new_england = 0.6 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = communism } add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_new_england = -0.3 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_new_england = -0.5 } }

			subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_drift = 50 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { lr_drift = 0.03 }
			subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_reg_new_england = lr_drift }
			clamp_variable = { var = LR_usa_reg_new_england min = 0 max = 100 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_sum = LR_usa_reg_new_england }
			add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_count = 1 }
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { OR = { state = 357 OR = { state = 1162 state = 860 } state = 1163 state = 1164 state = 1165 } }

				}

					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } }
				}

				else_if = {
					limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { LR_usa_reg_mountain_west < 35 } } }
					if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } }
					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } }
				}
				else = {
					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } }
					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_state = { OR = { OR = { state = 385 state = 739 } state = 386 } } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pacific = 0.3 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = communism } add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pacific = 0.2 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pacific = -0.2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { lr_drift = LR_usa_reg_pacific }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_drift = 50 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { lr_drift = 0.03 }
			subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pacific = lr_drift }
			clamp_variable = { var = LR_usa_reg_pacific min = 0 max = 100 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_sum = LR_usa_reg_pacific }
			add_to_variable = { LR_usa_reg_count = 1 }
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { OR = { OR = { state = 385 state = 739 } state = 386 } }
				if = {
					limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pacific > 64 } } }
					if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } }
					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pacific < 35 } } }
					if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } }
					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } }
				}
				else = {
					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_loyal } }
					if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_reg_unrest } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_avg = 50 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_usa_reg_count > 0 } }
			set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_avg = LR_usa_reg_sum }
			divide_variable = { LR_usa_reg_avg = LR_usa_reg_count }
		}
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_stab = LR_usa_reg_avg }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_reg_stab = 50 }
		multiply_variable = { LR_usa_reg_stab = 0.003 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pp = LR_usa_reg_avg }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pp = 50 }
		multiply_variable = { LR_usa_reg_pp = 0.008 }
		# Well-held regions win the ruling party votes; a country in revolt loses them.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_usa_reg_avg > 60 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = 0.005 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = communism } add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.005 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = 0.005 } }
			if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = 0.005 } }
		}
	}
}

lr_usa_congress_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_government = democratic
			NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_congress }
		}
		set_country_flag = LR_usa_congress
		set_variable = { LR_usa_house = 230 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_senate = 50 }
		set_variable = { LR_usa_cg_months = 0 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_congress }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = LR_usa_congress
			NOT = { has_government = democratic }
		}
		clr_country_flag = LR_usa_congress
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_usa_congress }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_usa_congress }
		add_to_variable = { LR_usa_cg_months = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_usa_cg_months > 23 } }
			set_variable = { LR_usa_cg_months = 0 }
			lr_usa_congress_election = yes
			news_event = { id = lr_usacg.1 }
		}
		lr_usa_congress_update = yes
	}
}

# Seats from the ruling party's popularity (half) and the regions' support (half), with a little luck.
lr_usa_congress_election = {
	set_temp_variable = { lr_share = party_popularity@democratic }
	multiply_temp_variable = { lr_share = 0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { lr_reg = LR_usa_reg_avg }
	multiply_temp_variable = { lr_reg = 0.005 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { lr_share = lr_reg }
	set_temp_variable = { lr_luck = random }
	multiply_temp_variable = { lr_luck = 0.1 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_luck = 0.05 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { lr_share = lr_luck }
	set_variable = { LR_usa_house = lr_share }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_house = 435 }
	round_variable = LR_usa_house
	set_variable = { LR_usa_senate = lr_share }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_senate = 96 }
	round_variable = LR_usa_senate
	lr_usa_congress_update = yes
}

lr_usa_congress_update = {
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_usa_house min = 0 max = 435 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_usa_senate min = 0 max = 96 }
	set_variable = { LR_usa_cg_pp = LR_usa_house }
	subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_cg_pp = 218 }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_cg_pp = 0.002 }
	set_variable = { LR_usa_cg_stab = LR_usa_senate }
	subtract_from_variable = { LR_usa_cg_stab = 48 }
	multiply_variable = { LR_usa_cg_stab = 0.002 }
}
# kr_layout: state numbers translated
